packages.name: Personal Banking Classic
packages.description: Standard retail banking package for individual salaried and non-salaried customers.
exemptions: Monthly salary transfer of AED 5,000 or more
Customers maintaining active personal/auto/home loans or overdraft facilities

policies.title: Key Facts Statement (KFS) - Current and Savings Accounts
policies.standard_min_balance: AED 3,000 monthly average relationship balance across standard Classic accounts
policies.digital_savings_min_balance: AED 5,000 monthly average balance for standard digital savings account
policies.terms_summary: Customers are required to maintain a minimum monthly average relationship balance of AED 3,000 under Personal Banking Classic. If the balance falls below AED 3,000, a monthly maintenance/fall-below fee of AED 26.25 applies. This fee is waived for payroll customers receiving AED 5,000+ monthly salary, UAE Nationals, Youth accounts, and active loan borrowers.

policies.title: Personal Banking Schedule of Charges
policies.terms_summary: Comprehensive schedule of fees, charges, transaction tariffs, fall-below rates, and foreign exchange margins for Emirates NBD retail banking products in the UAE.

products.name: Millionaire Account
products.summary: Specialized savings prize account offering entries into quarterly draws of AED 1,000,000 and monthly prize draws.
products.promotional_features: Earn chances to win quarterly prizes of AED 1,000,000, monthly prizes of AED 10,000, plus special booster certificates.

inherited_terms.min_monthly_balance: AED 3,000 (minimum monthly average balance under Personal Banking Classic terms)
inherited_terms.digital_savings_min_balance: AED 5,000 (if opened as standard digital savings variant)
inherited_terms.salary_waiver: AED 5,000 monthly salary transfer waives the fall-below fee
inherited_terms.governing_document: Key Facts Statement (KFS) - Current and Savings Accounts (https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/KFS/cash)
